stage0.summary: Stage 0 evidence integrity is blocking for end-to-end transactional guarantees and full memory-state binding.

statusLegend.CURRENT: Implemented Foundation — exists and is evidence-backed; may not complete full product workflow
statusLegend.IN_DEVELOPMENT: In Integration — actively being connected into the end-to-end product
statusLegend.TARGET: Target Architecture — defined destination capability not yet implemented
statusLegend.EXPERIMENTAL: Experimental — research or evaluation surface without production commitment
statusLegend.LIMITATION: Known Limitation — restricts the associated guarantee

capabilities.name: Execution isolation & snap-rollback
capabilities.summary: WASM sandbox with microsecond-class init, native snapshot of linear memory/globals/tables, sub-ms to low-tens-ms rollback for small-to-medium state, capability-gated WASI.
limitations: Large-state snapshots scale with size/compressibility
Full end-to-end cold-start higher than pure sandbox init
Governs WASM guest↔host boundary; does not intercept LLM tool choice today
capabilities.target: Broader agent tool execution coverage beyond pure WASM/WASI boundary

capabilities.name: Proof Capsules / ExecutionReceipt
capabilities.summary: Produced on execution: digests, capability evidence, snapshot, failure/rollback, redaction, limitations[] (always non-empty), optional Ed25519 signature, memory modes when feature-enabled. Portable signed evidence of what the runtime observed and enforced.
limitations: runtime_attestation_only
does_not_prove_correct_execution
does_not_prove_absence_of_external_side_effects
does_not_guarantee_full_deterministic_replay
does_not_include_raw_snapshot_memory
trusts_nexus_runtime_and_host_boundary
capabilities.target: Portable evidence fully binding action + authority + memory context under Change Gate

capabilities.name: Public Proof Capsule Explorer (web UI)
capabilities.summary: Browser Explorer ships for fixture inspection: dual scenarios, field explainers, mandatory limitations[], structural checks, downloadable structure-identical capsules. Schema and artifacts remain Implemented Foundations; production cryptographic verification and durable trust anchors stay Target / In Integration.
limitations: Educational inspection of fixtures — not live runtime stream
Structural checks are non-cryptographic
Demo signatures are not production trust anchors

capabilities.name: Capability authority
capabilities.summary: Ed25519-signed tokens, attenuation chains (narrow only), denial on missing/expired/revoked, MemoryRecall gating, rate limits, policy profiles.
limitations: Memory remains advisory input; Nexus is sole execution authority today
inDevelopment: Durable end-to-end authority chain across full Nexus-IQ path and Change Gate (Stage 0)
capabilities.target: Full durable capability authority enforced at every transactional stage

capabilities.name: AEON-IQ memory plane & evidence binding
capabilities.summary: Transparent proxy, persistent memory, retrieval logs, schema-contract verifier (PR #21), Ed25519 countersign foundations, HMAC digests when keys present, modes recorded in capsules. Full production RecallEnvelope path and live verification under Stage 0.
currentFoundations: Attestation modes: Attested, AttestedWithRecall, Advisory, Degraded, Absent
limitations: Incomplete binding yields Advisory/Degraded/Absent modes
Residual risks on timeline completeness, key management, clock skew
capabilities.target: Cryptographically bound, verifiable memory context in every receipt under transactional guarantees

capabilities.name: Transactional Change Gate
capabilities.summary: First product: stage → validate → approve → commit/abort + compensation for consequential agent changes. Foundations exist; full public product surface is under construction. Stage 0 evidence integrity is blocking.
limitations: Not a finished public product surface
Must never be presented as currently deployable end-to-end
Nexus does not yet sit between LLM and tool choices
capabilities.target: Complete transactional semantics: stage, constrain, validate, commit only what survives, emit binding evidence, rollback/compensate on failure

capabilities.name: Production-grade signing identity & external anchors
capabilities.summary: Durable trust anchors and external anchoring for Proof Capsules beyond opt-in runtime signing.
limitations: Current capsules may use opt-in Ed25519; production trust model incomplete

capabilities.name: Execution governance scope
capabilities.summary: Nexus governs the sandboxed WASM guest↔host boundary (WASI host-calls). It does not currently intercept model tool decisions or route providers.
limitations: Full agent/MCP governance wrapper is destination architecture
Do not demo 'block the model tool call' until that layer ships
